nodes.name: BaseParameterHolder.java
nodes.summary: ThreadLocal-based holder that stores per-request base parameters (trace id, user id, etc.) in a map so they can be propagated across threads and filters.

nodes.name: BaseParameterHolder
nodes.summary: Static utility class wrapping a ThreadLocal<Map<String,String>> with set/get/remove accessors for individual parameters and whole-map operations.

nodes.name: BaseParameterFilter.java
nodes.summary: Servlet filter that extracts base parameters (trace id, user id, channel, request body) from incoming HTTP requests, stores them in BaseParameterHolder and SLF4J MDC, and cleans up after the chain.

nodes.name: BaseParameterFilter
nodes.summary: OncePerRequestFilter implementation populating ThreadLocal base parameters and MDC entries for every request, guaranteeing cleanup in a finally block.

nodes.name: doFilterInternal
nodes.summary: Reads the request body and headers, pushes trace/user/channel parameters into BaseParameterHolder and MDC, continues the filter chain, then removes all parameters and MDC keys in finally.

nodes.name: ExtCachingServiceInstanceListSupplier.java
nodes.summary: Extension of Spring Cloud's CachingServiceInstanceListSupplier that applies a FilterLoadBalance strategy to cached service instance lists for gray-release routing.

nodes.name: ExtCachingServiceInstanceListSupplier
nodes.summary: Caching supplier decorator that post-processes the cached instance list through the injected FilterLoadBalance before returning it to the load balancer.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Overrides the cached list retrieval to map each instance list through FilterLoadBalance.selectServer, applying gray filtering to cached results.

nodes.name: FilterLoadBalance.java
nodes.summary: SPI interface defining the selectServer contract used to filter candidate service instances during load balancing in the gray-transition framework.

nodes.name: FilterLoadBalance
nodes.summary: Single-method interface whose selectServer(List<ServiceInstance>) extension point lets strategies trim the candidate instance list.

nodes.name: GrayLoadBalanceAutoConfiguration.java
nodes.summary: Spring auto-configuration registering the DefaultFilterLoadBalance strategy and the ServerGrayFilter bean for gray-release load balancing.

nodes.name: GrayLoadBalanceAutoConfiguration
nodes.summary: Configuration class importing EnhanceLoadBalancerClientConfiguration and exposing DefaultFilterLoadBalance and ServerGrayFilter beans.

nodes.name: ContextHandler.java
nodes.summary: SPI interface abstracting how the gray-transition framework reads header values from the current request, with gateway and WebMVC implementations.

nodes.name: ContextHandler
nodes.summary: Single-method interface exposing getValueFromHeader(name) so gray filters stay decoupled from the underlying web stack.

nodes.name: EnhanceServiceInstanceListSupplierBuilder.java
nodes.summary: Enhanced fork of Spring Cloud's ServiceInstanceListSupplier builder that wires discovery-client, caching, health-check, zone-preference, weighted, sticky-session and subset delegates while injecting the gray FilterLoadBalance into the caching layer.
nodes.languageNotes: Fluent builder heavily using Spring Cloud LoadBalancer delegate suppliers; overloaded withX methods for reactive (WebClient) and blocking (RestTemplate/RestClient) variants.

nodes.name: EnhanceServiceInstanceListSupplierBuilder
nodes.summary: Builder composing a chain of ServiceInstanceListSupplier delegates (discovery, caching via ExtCachingServiceInstanceListSupplier, health checks, zone preference, weighting, sticky sessions, subsets) into the final supplier used by the load balancer.

nodes.name: withBlockingDiscoveryClient
nodes.summary: Configures the base creator to build a blocking DiscoveryClient-backed ServiceInstanceListSupplier, warning when a reactive discovery client is already present.

nodes.name: withDiscoveryClient
nodes.summary: Configures the base creator to build a reactive DiscoveryClient-backed ServiceInstanceListSupplier, warning when only a blocking discovery client is available.

nodes.name: withCaching
nodes.summary: Adds a caching delegate that wraps the delegate supplier in ExtCachingServiceInstanceListSupplier with the available CacheManager and the gray FilterLoadBalance strategy.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Applies the base creator and all registered delegate creators in order to produce the final composed ServiceInstanceListSupplier for a given ConfigurableApplicationContext.

nodes.name: healthCheckServiceInstanceListSupplier
nodes.summary: Builds a reactive HealthCheckServiceInstanceListSupplier that probes instances via WebClient against their health-check path and treats HTTP 200 as alive.

nodes.name: blockingHealthCheckServiceInstanceListSupplier
nodes.summary: Builds blocking HealthCheckServiceInstanceListSupplier variants (RestTemplate and RestClient overloads) that probe instance health endpoints inside Mono.defer and mark HTTP 200 responses as alive.

nodes.name: EnhanceLoadBalancerClientConfiguration.java
nodes.summary: LoadBalancer client configuration providing the RoundRobinLoadBalancer bean plus a matrix of conditional ServiceInstanceListSupplier configurations (caching, zone-preference, health-check, sticky-session, weighted, subset, retry-aware) for both reactive and blocking modes, all built via EnhanceServiceInstanceListSupplierBuilder.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses nested @Configuration classes with custom Condition implementations (matches methods) keyed on loadbalancer configuration properties.

nodes.name: EnhanceLoadBalancerClientConfiguration
nodes.summary: Top-level load balancer configuration whose reactorServiceInstanceLoadBalancer bean and nested conditional configurations assemble gray-aware supplier chains per client profile.

nodes.name: AbstractServerFilter.java
nodes.summary: Abstract base class for server-instance filters that iterates candidate instances and removes those rejected by the subclass-implemented doFilter predicate.

nodes.name: AbstractServerFilter
nodes.summary: Template-method base filter: filter(List) mutates the candidate list in place by removing instances for which the abstract doFilter returns false.

nodes.name: filter
nodes.summary: Iterates the candidate server list and removes each instance rejected by the subclass doFilter hook, returning the filtered list.

nodes.name: ServerGrayFilter.java
nodes.summary: Gray-release server filter that compares the gray flag from the request (header or ThreadLocal) against Nacos instance metadata to keep only matching normal/gray instances, throwing DaMaiFrameException when no instance matches.

nodes.name: ServerGrayFilter
nodes.summary: AbstractServerFilter implementation resolving the request's gray marker via ContextHandler/BaseParameterHolder and matching it against instance metadata to route gray traffic.

nodes.name: doFilter
nodes.summary: Resolves gray markers from the request header or BaseParameterHolder and from Nacos instance metadata, validates consistency across candidates, throws when the gray set would be empty, and decides whether the given instance survives.

nodes.name: DefaultFilterLoadBalance.java
nodes.summary: Default FilterLoadBalance implementation that runs the candidate server list through every registered AbstractServerFilter strategy.

nodes.name: DefaultFilterLoadBalance
nodes.summary: FilterLoadBalance implementation chaining all injected AbstractServerFilter instances over the candidate list in selectServer.

nodes.name: GatewayContextAutoConfiguration.java
nodes.summary: Gateway-side auto-configuration registering the route/clear global filters and the GatewayContextHandler bean for the gray-transition framework.

nodes.name: GatewayContextAutoConfiguration
nodes.summary: Configuration class exposing GatewayWorkRouteFilter, GatewayWorkClearFilter and GatewayContextHandler beans for Spring Cloud Gateway deployments.

nodes.name: GatewayWorkClearFilter.java
nodes.summary: Gateway global filter that clears the ThreadLocal gateway context after routing so request state does not leak between requests on reused threads.

nodes.name: GatewayWorkClearFilter
nodes.summary: Ordered GlobalFilter calling GatewayContextHolder.removeCurrentGatewayContext before continuing the chain, ordered to run after the route filter.

nodes.name: GatewayWorkRouteFilter.java
nodes.summary: Gateway global filter that stores the current ServerWebExchange into the ThreadLocal GatewayContextHolder at the start of routing for later header access.

nodes.name: GatewayWorkRouteFilter
nodes.summary: Ordered GlobalFilter that captures the exchange into GatewayContextHolder before delegating to the rest of the filter chain.

nodes.name: GatewayContextHandler.java
nodes.summary: Gateway implementation of ContextHandler that reads request headers from the ServerWebExchange held in GatewayContextHolder.

nodes.name: GatewayContextHandler
nodes.summary: ContextHandler implementation resolving header values through the ThreadLocal-stored ServerWebExchange, with null-safe Optional chains.

nodes.name: GatewayContextHolder.java
nodes.summary: ThreadLocal holder for the current gateway request context (ServerWebExchange) used by gray filters in the gateway module.

nodes.name: GatewayContextHolder
nodes.summary: Static ThreadLocal-backed holder exposing get/remove accessors for the per-request gateway context containing the ServerWebExchange.

nodes.name: WebMvcContextAutoConfiguration.java
nodes.summary: WebMVC-side auto-configuration registering the WebMvcContextHandler bean for the gray-transition framework in servlet-based services.

nodes.name: WebMvcContextAutoConfiguration
nodes.summary: Configuration class exposing the WebMvcContextHandler bean used to read headers from the current servlet request.

nodes.name: WebMvcContextHandler.java
nodes.summary: WebMVC implementation of ContextHandler that reads request headers from the current HttpServletRequest obtained via RequestContextHolder.

nodes.name: WebMvcContextHandler
nodes.summary: ContextHandler implementation that pulls the current HttpServletRequest from RequestContextHolder's ServletRequestAttributes to resolve header values.

nodes.name: BaseThreadPool.java
nodes.summary: Base thread-pool support class that wraps Runnable/Callable tasks to propagate SLF4J MDC and BaseParameterHolder ThreadLocal context from the submitting thread to worker threads.

nodes.name: BaseThreadPool
nodes.summary: Provides wrapTask/preprocess/postProcess helpers that snapshot and restore MDC and base-parameter contexts around task execution in pooled threads.

nodes.name: wrapTask
nodes.summary: Wraps a Runnable or Callable so the captured parent MDC and BaseParameterHolder contexts are installed before execution and restored afterwards.

nodes.name: preprocess
nodes.summary: Snapshots the worker thread's current MDC/parameter maps, installs the parent contexts, and returns the previous state for later restoration.

nodes.name: postProcess
nodes.summary: Restores the worker thread's original MDC and BaseParameterHolder maps after task completion to prevent context leakage between pooled tasks.
